direct_claims: This chart shows the estimated annual number of deaths from protein-energy malnutrition, by age, worldwide.
The data is produced by IHME, Global Burden of Disease (2025).
Protein-energy malnutrition results from insufficient caloric and protein intake.
The estimates come with wide uncertainties, especially for countries with poor vital registration.
The age groups considered are Under-5s, 5-14 years old, 15-49 years old, 50-69 years old, and 70+ years old.
The chart notes that comparisons between countries and over time may be affected by differences in diagnostic practices and death certification.
